method: build_klein_* (all Klein Flux2 builders) + all flux-based builders
name: ComfyUI v0.27.0 — Native Int8 Quantization for Convolution Models
notes: Tier 1. Framework upgrade. Native int8 quantized model loading with Turing-GPU-aware optimizations and improved LoRA handling. On 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti, int8 quant allows running Klein-9B within VRAM budget. Also adds ConditioningMultiply node. Drop-in framework upgrade; no pipeline rewrites required.

name: LTX-2.3 — Kijai ComfyUI repack (updated Jun 30 2026)
notes: Tier 1. Major generational upgrade over LTX 0.9.8: adds audio-to-video, video-to-video, multi-language (9 languages). 5.1M downloads. Requires ComfyUI-LTXVideo node pack update. The 13B model may be tight at fp16; use quantized variant.

name: LTX-2.3 nvfp4 / int8 ConvRot ComfyUI pack (Jul 5 2026)
notes: Tier 1. nvfp4 runs on RTX 5060 Ti Blackwell FP4 tensor cores natively — hardware-matched. Quantized variants reduce peak VRAM well below 16 GB. Precision-reduced versions of the well-characterised Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy (5.1M downloads).

name: Google TIPSv2 DPT — Unified Depth + Surface Normals + Segmentation
notes: Tier 1. Single DPT-head model covering depth estimation, surface normals, and semantic segmentation simultaneously. Apache-2.0. Four size variants (b14 ~1.5 GB to g14 ~10 GB); l14 (~3 GB) recommended. Replaces both da3_large and separate normals model with one inference pass. Google demo space live.

name: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL — GRPO Reinforcement Learning post-training
notes: Tier 2. GRPO-based RL post-training on Qwen-Image-2.0. Introduces hybrid classifier-free guidance, intra-group reward filtering, per-category reward weight calibration, trajectory-level velocity matching. Measurably improves visual quality and instruction-following on both T2I and image editing. Weights expected within 1-2 weeks based on Qwen team track record.

name: Qwen-Image-Flash — Few-step distillation of Qwen-Image models
notes: Tier 2. Systematic recipe for 2-4 step distillation of Qwen-Image visual generative models covering T2I and instruction-guided editing. Optimizes data composition ratios, teacher guidance schedules, task mixtures. Drop-in weight file if released.

name: Hunyuan3D 2.1 — PBR Material Generation
notes: Tier 2. Adds full PBR output (albedo/roughness/metallic) from single-image input. Community mirrors available; official Tencent HF org release pending. 8-bit MLX quantized variant available (ddalcu/Hunyuan3D-2.1-MLX-Serve-8bit) with optional UniRig auto-rigging. VRAM: full-precision ~14-20 GB; wait for official quantized weights for 16 GB hardware.

name: AnchorSplat — 3D-Native Gaussian Splatting Detail Synthesis (ECCV 2026)
notes: Tier 2. Post-processing augment for 3DGS output from HunYuan3D. Source-free; no original images required. Point Anchor Mechanism for geometric consistency. MIT license. <6 GB VRAM. Claimed 10^5x faster than iterative densification.

name: SAM3.1 — Incremental update to facebook/sam3
notes: Tier 2. Improves concept-prompt accuracy over SAM3. Ecosystem activity spiked this week: CoreML quant (Nobody111/SAM3.1-CoreML, Jun 29), Grounded-SAM3.1 space (Jul 6). VRAM similar to SAM3 (~6-8 GB). Caveat: gated HF repo — requires access approval.

name: FLUX.2-klein-9B Manga Colorization by Reference LoRA
notes: Tier 2. Reference-controlled colorization LoRA on Klein-9B for manga/flat-art inputs. Uses refcontrol conditioning. Apache-2.0. VRAM risk: Klein-9B base needs fp8/int4 quant on 16 GB (requires ComfyUI v0.27.0 int8 support).

name: TeleStyle V2 — Self-distillation + DMD for diverse style reference
notes: Tier 3. Qwen2.5-VL-7B encoder + Distribution Matching Distillation; handles photo/artwork/text style references. Stronger content-preserving style adherence than current build. VRAM: ~14 GB at fp16 for VLM encoder. Weights not yet confirmed public.

name: Z-Image Turbo++ — 2-step distillation of 6B Z-Image DiT
notes: Tier 3. 6B single-stream DiT outperforms Flux on GenEval; 2-step student via distribution-aligned adversarial learning. Comparable speed to Klein 4-step at higher fidelity. At fp8 fits 16 GB. Weights not yet released (Norby/Z_Image_diffusion_models HF namespace exists but empty).

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video — ic-LoRA on Bernini-R video backbone
notes: Tier 3. Video head/face swap ic-LoRA on ByteDance/Bernini-R (I2V). 279 HF likes. Video-oriented vs static-image Klein. Bernini-R VRAM likely >16 GB for full-res video. Monitor as potential augment for video output use cases.

name: EasyCache — Training-free runtime-adaptive caching for WAN and HunyuanVideo
notes: Tier 3. Training-free caching of transformation vectors during denoising. Validated on WAN 2.1 + HunyuanVideo. No ComfyUI node found. Watch for implementation.

name: Sol Video Inference Engine — Agent-based multi-technique video acceleration
notes: Tier 3. Combines caching, sparse attention, token pruning, quantization, kernel fusion adaptively. Covers WAN + HunyuanVideo. Research-only; no code or ComfyUI node released as of scan date.

name: CanonSwap — Canonical Space Video Face Swapping
notes: Tier 3. Decoupled motion/appearance with partial identity modulation in canonical space. Strong temporal consistency — weakness of current ReActor+CodeFormer. No public weights. Watch for implementation.

name: DreamID-V — Diffusion Transformer Video Face Swapping
notes: Tier 3. DiT backbone with Identity-Coherence Reinforcement Learning. Superior identity preservation vs MTB. 53 HF upvotes. No public weights or ComfyUI node.

name: 4KAgent — Agentic Any-Image to 4K Super-Resolution
notes: Tier 3. Modular Profiling + Perception + Restoration agent pipeline for 4K upscaling with face sub-pipeline. 107 HF upvotes. SUPIR-adjacent. No ComfyUI node or weights found.

name: NTIRE 2026 Real-World Face Restoration Challenge — Results
notes: Tier 3. Compilation of top approaches from 10 competing teams, all outperforming CodeFormer on perceptual quality. Individual team weights may surface on HF. Monitor for follow-up releases.

name: InSpace — TRELLIS2-Based Indoor 360° 3D Scene Generation
notes: Tier 3. Generates full indoor 3D scenes from panoramic inputs. ECCV 2026. Task scope differs from stereo-pair output of build_2d_to_sbs. Research-only, no VRAM data, no ComfyUI node.

name: Anchoring on Reality: Breaking the Pseudo-Target Ceiling in Makeup Transfer
notes: Tier 3. Two-stage makeup transfer with reality-anchored refinement. Research only; no public weights. MF2K dataset. Tangential to build_photobooth style consistency.

name: codewhizamit/faceswap — REJECTED
notes: REJECTED. No model card, no architecture description, zero downloads, no provenance. Do not integrate.

name: Grok Image — xAI ComfyUI partner node (API-only)
notes: NO-FIND. API-only; no local weights. Incompatible with offline RTX 5060 Ti deployment.
